result.summary: Headings from macro output (such as {{include(Page)}}) no longer get section edit links or count as sections. Macros declare `:sections => true` at definition; only `collapse` does. Other macro output is wrapped in internal markers during rendering, and `parse_sections` skips the headings between them. Nested macros (an include inside a collapse) are handled by tracking macro depth, so the markers are only removed at the outermost call. Included headings are still rendered normally. check-fast and the full non-system gate both pass. Nothing was committed or pushed.

changes.summary: Adds NO_SECTION markers and SECTION_TAG_RE; parse_sections skips headings inside non-section macro output and removes markers; inject_macros wraps output of macros without :sections => true; textilizable strips markers at the outermost call (@macro_depth == 0).
macro accepts :sections option (assert_valid_keys); collapse declared with :sections => true; exec_macro tracks @macro_depth around macro execution; documented the option.
Three new tests: included page headings get no edit link and local numbering is right; include nested in collapse is skipped; macro with and without :sections => true.

The skill tells you to run `bin/rails test test/unit/issue_test.rb -n test_create`, but Minitest on this Ruby 4 setup warns to use -i/--include. Not a failure, but noisy.
